recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, deflated red heart-shaped balloon with realistic rubber wrinkles and a knotted tail, set against a flat, pale blue-grey background with a vertical strip of muted multi-colored squares on the far left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject versus expansive negative space
High-contrast red against low-saturation pastel background
Organic, wrinkled texture of the balloon versus the geometric rigidity of the side color bar
Soft, diffused lighting creating subtle shadows beneath the balloon
coreInvariants: The heart must be deflated and wrinkled
The background must be a singular, flat pastel tone
A vertical color-grid strip must occupy the left margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The deflated heart is perfectly centered, occupying approximately 20% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red heart acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central red heart, then moves left to the vertical color bar, then scans the surrounding negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; the vastness of the background emphasizes the smallness and vulnerability of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale blue-grey (background) providing a cool, neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant primary red (subject) for immediate visual impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted pastels (left strip) including lavender, mint, and peach.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center, low saturation in the periphery, creating a 'pop' effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat, pale blue-grey background. On the far left edge, add a thin vertical column of small, muted colored squares (lavender, green, blue, pink, tan).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a highly detailed, deflated red rubber heart-shaped balloon in the exact center. Ensure the balloon has realistic wrinkles, highlights, and a small knot at the bottom point. Add a very soft, diffused shadow beneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the heart deflated rather than inflated?
Is the color bar only on the left edge?
Is the background a singular, flat pastel color?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the color bar on the left
Degree of deflation/wrinkling in the heart
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos or text
Exact sequence of colors in the left bar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the left color strip is vertical and geometric.
Check that the red is the only high-saturation element.
Verify the texture looks like matte rubber.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject: Deflated Object] + [Color: Vibrant Primary] + [Background: Flat Pastel] + [Graphic Device: Left-side vertical color grid] = Minimalist Conceptual Art.
